Occurrence definition: Eligible destination becomes visible
Critical fields: route; category; campaign source where permitted

Occurrence definition: User activates store destination
Observable app instance opens for first time
Source: Permitted app measurement or store aggregate
Identity or deduplication key: App instance where permitted; never owner
Critical fields: OS; version; route when lawfully available

Occurrence definition: Input attempt starts at documented UI point
Attempt terminates or reaches declared timeout
User confirms or corrects recognised item
Usable indicative result is actually displayed
Advertising export: Exclude asset and premium amounts by default

Occurrence definition: User begins personalised enquiry
Backend accepts unique valid request
Critical fields: opportunity; category; eligibility country; contact availability
Advertising export: Map to generate_lead only where permitted and meaningful

Occurrence definition: Request meets written service criteria
Partner acknowledges delivered request
Partner gives substantive accepted/rejected/pending decision
Formal personalised quote issued
Cover effective under contract evidence
Advertising export: Completed transaction mapping only if meaning fits

Occurrence definition: Contractual fee condition satisfied
Advertising export: Candidate primary optimisation signal; consent assessed

Occurrence definition: Fee recorded as earned under agreed convention
Identity or deduplication key: Fee identity linked to payable event
Critical fields: fee amount; currency; earned date; split treatment
Advertising export: Value only with defined nonduplicating convention

Occurrence definition: Earned fee partly or fully withdrawn
Advertising export: Use platform-specific adjustment only if supported

Occurrence definition: Actual receipt allocated to earned fee
Owner saves an additional collection item
Advertising export: Useful task signal; no automatic payable event

Occurrence definition: Owner completes a defined documentation task
Owner requests a real policy coverage review
Eligible due policy renews
Critical fields: due date; term; status; rights reference
Advertising export: Fee only if renewal remuneration earned
